title: Getting Started with ASP.NET Core MVC
description: Introduction to ASP.NET Core MVC, history, features, and creating your first application.
longDescription: This module introduces you to ASP.NET Core MVC, its architecture, and helps you create your first application. You will learn about the MVC pattern, how ASP.NET Core compares to older frameworks, and how to set up your development environment.
whatYouLearn: Understand what ASP.NET Core MVC is and its architecture
Learn about MVC pattern and how it works
Compare ASP.NET Core with ASP.NET and ASP.NET MVC
Create your first ASP.NET Core MVC application
Build a complete CRUD application from scratch
